Wayfair is hiring a Software Engineer I to design and build reliable, scalable, maintainable applications while developing early-career engineering talent. The role contributes to engineering quality, architecture and code reviews, documentation, and collaborative solutions to business and technical problems.

Responsibilities
Support designing and perform hands-on building of applications that are reliable, scalable and easy to maintain
Ensure that engineering quality standards are met within your team
Contribute to architectural and code review discussions that impact our engineering ecosystem
Collaborate with leads and engineers on your team to solve a wide variety of business and technical problems
Ensure our systems are properly documented
Contribute to the growth and development of the Wayfair engineering organization
Qualification
Software Development (Backend/Full-Stack)
Object-Oriented Programming
SQL
Java
Python
.NET
Data Structures and Algorithms
Code Debugging
Agile
Required
1-3 years of transferable software development experience (backend and/or full stack, including some frontend) in a corporate environment, including internship and co-op experience
Bachelor's in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or another related technical discipline
Knowledge of and experience working with object-oriented programming languages
Experience or exposure to SQL, Java, Python, and .NET
Authorization to work in the United States on a full-time basis without the need for current or future employer sponsorship
Preferred
Excellent team player with a passion for collaboration
Familiarity with creating software tools and functionality, debugging code, and successfully incorporating feedback into your work
Strong skills in solving complex problems with simple abstract solutions
An interest in working with big data and machine learning
Experience with using cloud platforms to solve problems
Experience working in agile environments
Strong communication skills and the ability to take on projects or tool autonomously
Benefits
Full health benefits (Medical, Dental, Vision, HSA/FSA) on day one for eligible employees.
No-cost access to 2nd.MD, a virtual expert medical consultation and navigation service.
Global Traveler Health Insurance through GeoBlue.
24/7 access to mental, financial, physical and emotional wellbeing support, plus an enhanced offering of therapy and coaching.
Automatic enrollment into Basic Life and Accidental Death & Disability Insurance.
401(k) matching with immediate vesting.
Paid Parental Leave.
Surrogacy & Adoption Reimbursement.
Caregiver Services.
Tuition Reimbursement.
Wayfair Employee Discount.
Gym/Fitness Discounts.
Exclusive access to thousands of perks & discounts through BenefitHub.
Yearly match up to $500 for personal donations made by employees to registered 501(c)(3) nonprofits.
Boston-based hybrid work arrangement: 3 days in office (Tuesday–Thursday) and 2 days remote (Monday and Friday).
Accelerated Onboarding Program with a cohort of peers, collaborative learning, guidance from a manager, mentorship from a dedicated Tech Coach, clear development milestones, and exposure to applied AI tools.
Paid volunteer time off.
